Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.curse.j.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.curse.j.startdescription: 'A friend of mine - he collects curios. Now there is something he wishes he had not collected. But - how should I put this? It does not wish him to uncollect it.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.observe.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.observe.startdescription: 'The clouds have been called 'the dancers of the lower skies'. At sunset, I am their audience. I know their moods and modes, very well. But lately there has been a change. The dancers of the lower skies have become first coquettish - now insistent.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.opera.a.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.opera.a.startdescription: ''Apollo and Marsyas'. The score had been thought lost… and I am pleased to say I played my small part in its recovery. It is rather old. I have been asked to help arrange it to suit, ah, contemporary expectations.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.pan.jso.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.pan.jso.startdescription: 'I have heard of this venture in Germany, where the customers go in as bankers and come out as painters. I am not interested in bankers or in painting usually, but this…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.project.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.project.startdescription: 'I did not know Zuthimalim Zidane. But I know enough who mourn for him. ' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.wound.j.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.agdistis.wound.j.startdescription: 'There are many of us, you know, who have what you might call unhealed wounds… and many of us would not choose to heal them.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.hunt.chan.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.hunt.chan.startdescription: 'The labhite Abecassis of Marrakech has begun to - let us be tactful here - to behave without decorum. I wish to understand why.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.lost.find.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.lost.find.startdescription: 'Yes, I am counted among the Long. 'Immortal' is too optimistic a word. All of us have our patrons. If we are lucky, we never draw their direct attention...' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.observe.s.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.observe.s.startdescription: 'What is happening in the West, I wonder? If it is something old, I might desire to witness it. If it is something new, I might desire to chronicle it. If it is both… then I should make plans to travel there immediately.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.omen.hori.label: On the Other Horizon
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.omen.hori.startdescription: 'Passage to Ys is forbidden… so thoroughly forbidden that even the laws against it are not generally known. But there are always exceptions. I imagine a librarian of the Watchman's Tree will understand exceptions.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.rising.js.label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.rising.js.startdescription: 'I have read of oracles like this 'Rising While', Librarian. Let me say this: they do not usually offer their services in times of peace and calm.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale>  as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.rite.awak.label: On the Sandalwood Saint
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.rite.awak.startdescription: 'This statuette in Strasbourg. I have people in the Church hierarchy, and I do not like what they are telling me…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.stalk.jso.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.aladim.stalk.jso.startdescription: ''She is the oldest of her kind still living; and she is dead.' That is how we are accustomed to speak of the Ligeian Medusa, who haunts the nights in Budapest… but now it seems she has begun to haunt the days.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.hunt.chan.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.hunt.chan.startdescription: 'Labhites are much favoured at the Labyrinth of Lions. Abecassis himself made a pilgrimage there not so long ago. When they break faith with the Lionsmith, the duty often falls to me and my companions - the duty to bring them to the Labyrinth for punishment.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.mob.json.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.mob.json.startdescription: 'I have a contract in Kaunas, Librarian. For the Reckoner war. Which side? Does it matter?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.mystical..label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.mystical..startdescription: 'Prophecy, Librarian; this is a time of prophecy.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.omen.dawn.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.omen.dawn.startdescription: 'There are prophecies of the Second Dawn, you know; of the Sun's rebirth. One of those prophecies is of 'the Unfettered Eye..'' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.project.s.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.project.s.startdescription: 'I abandoned the Empire's service long ago. That was not an easy choice. But some ties, I find even harder to loose.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.revolutio.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.revolutio.startdescription: 'An uprising in the Bounds - perhaps you've heard. They've sent to me for help…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.stalk.jso.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arthur.stalk.jso.startdescription: 'You remember, perhaps, that I am a student of Illumination. My teachers at the Labyrinth of Lions have set a challenge that I must complete before I can pass to a higher level of initiation.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.box.json.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.box.json.startdescription: ''Who was the Watchman when the light went out?' 'In the dark.' No; It only works in Vak.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.lost.find.j.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.lost.find.j.startdescription: 'I wonder how many of us tell you the truth? I wonder if any of us do? I wonder if you are ever tempted to stuff our eyes with nonsense? I am sorry. This is unhelpful of me. Let's talk about petals.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.mob.json.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.mob.json.startdescription: 'This century, Librarian, this century. A knife beneath every pillow. I am minded, this season, to be a collector of knives.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.opera.wings.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.opera.wings.startdescription: ''The Invisible Opera'. I've suggested they perform it in the dark. Too rarely does anyone listen to what I am saying. Too often they think I'm joking.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moth> as their <sprite name=moth> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.rising.json.label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.rising.json.startdescription: 'The 'Oracle of the Rising While'. I asked her a riddle; she had the temerity to ask me one in return. And so I am here.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.rite.renewa.label: On the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.arun.rite.renewa.startdescription: 'Something regrettable is due to occur at Gladwyn Lake, regrettably soon.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.hunt.chang.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.hunt.chang.startdescription: 'The Lionsmith is the patron of labhites; and of Mehrad, who is my dearest enemy. The Colonel is my patron, and the Lionsmith is to the Colonel as Mehrad is to me. It will please the Colonel to see this labhite die without honour. And now you know the pieces, and the game.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.mob.json.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.mob.json.startdescription: 'This stupid conflict is threatening my interests in Kaunas…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.observe.sc.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.azita.observe.sc.startdescription: 'My dearest enemy - Mehrad - has gone West to the Evening Isles. Before I follow him, I must know why.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]
